arditi_allpos.alpha_equiv_note: alpha_equiv is an ARITHMETIC conversion c * ||r_raw|| / ||h||_ref, where ||h||_ref was measured on PROMPT tokens under PREFILL-ONLY serving. This unit writes at decode positions too, where ||h|| differs, so the figure is for comparability with the prefill-only ladder and is NEVER a claim about the dose realised at decode. The measured realised dose is recorded beside it, per rung.
arditi_allpos.arm: the RAW Arditi refusal direction ADDED at coefficient c at EVERY position of EVERY forward — prefill AND every decode step (the paper's own configuration; c = 1.0 is its nominal)
arditi_allpos.cross_model_caveat: Served in the paper's own configuration -- the raw difference-of-means vector at coefficient c, added at every position of every forward (prefill AND decode). The other families' Arditi arms are served PREFILL-ONLY at alpha, a fraction of the residual norm. The two are not the same intervention and their doses are not the same quantity.

deviations_from_the_paper.rendering: apply_chat_template through the harness's one renderer (sisteer.models.build_chat_prompt), not their hardcoded per-family template strings.

arditi_allpos.dose_unit_description: c = the multiplier on the RAW Arditi difference of means: the served vector is c * r_raw at the served layer, with c = 1.0 the paper's nominal (arXiv 2406.11717; verified in their code, where select_direction returns the candidate unmodified and only the ABLATION hook normalises). Unlike residual_norm_fraction this is NOT normalised by ||h||, so the same c on two models is two different interventions -- which is why this unit is served on ONE model.

h_ref_provenance.instrument: HF forward, no steering — a property of the BASE model's residual stream. The RENDERING matches the served path; the ENGINE does not, so the realised dose is re-measured on the served path after baking
h_ref_provenance.measured_on: PROMPT tokens under PREFILL-ONLY serving — NOT at decode positions, which is why alpha_equiv is a labelled arithmetic conversion and never a realised-dose claim
h_ref_provenance.statistic: median over token rows of the POOLED set (259 confirmatory goals + 120 benign controls, harmful-weighted ~2:1), at the block OUTPUT of the served layer, under the served rendering

arditi_allpos.operation: activation addition (Arditi's induce half): h += vectors[l] at every row of every forward, BOS included, both phases
arditi_allpos.realised_dose_decode_measured_note: THE NUMERATOR. Each decode row is put through the REAL apply path under a DECODE HookContext and its edit is measured: the edit fires at decode positions (which no other level asserts) and its magnitude is exactly c x ||r_raw||. THE DENOMINATOR IS NOT a decode-time measurement: ||h||_ref and its p05/p95 were measured on PROMPT tokens under PREFILL-ONLY serving, and no decode-position residual norm exists for any target of this campaign — a producer holding no model cannot measure one. So this level is a served-path self-consistency check at three measured denominators, and the realised dose at decode is re-measured on the SERVED path at standup, which measure_href.py names as the authority.
arditi_allpos.scaling_method: vectors[l] <- c * r_raw; the served OP_ADD_VECTOR's coeff is 1.0, so the dose lives in the vector's norm and a rung is different BYTES, never a serve-time flag
arditi_allpos.stored_layer_note: a vector_all blob stores the SERVED block-output layer and _adapt_vector_all serves it AS STORED — the INVERSE of static_r at site='pre', which stores the FIT layer and is shifted by the adapter. Confusing the two steers a block early or late with every other signal healthy

checks.rule: torch.equal(new, r_raw * c) for vectors; the key set is EXACTLY MultiLayerVectorObject.save's, in its order, and every other key equals the reference's

checks.adapted_from: the FILE's bytes (a BytesIO re-serialization differs; the adapter reads the file in production)
checks.rule: one OP_ADD_VECTOR at the STORED layer (this kind serves what it stores); op/layer/positions/skip_bos/phase/coeff identical to the reference's, coeff exactly 1.0, vector == c x the reference's; adapted through the REGISTERED adapter so the fit/serve position guard and the spec-vs-bytes cross-checks run

lens_adapters.apply_hook_ops: the OUTPUT is bit-identical to h + c x r_raw under a PREFILL context, under a DECODE context, and with NO context, in fp32 and in the bf16 the worker materializes. The criterion is the OUTPUT, never a reconstructed (out - h) delta — that tolerance tracks ||h|| and false-failed qwen at 2.38e-7 against a 2.27e-7 bound

checks.direction_bound_to_fit: direction.pt's VALUE hash (the fit's own statistic: sha256 over json.dumps(tolist())) was compared against the fit record's selected.direction_sha256 AND against the arms table's approved fit before any rung was built, so the levels here are about the RIGHT artifact and not merely a self-consistent one
checks.rule: the op the REGISTERED adapter emits carries exactly c x the RAW fitted direction and the served output is h + that vector at EVERY row. ABSOLUTE, not relative: levels 1-3 compare a rung to its reference and would all pass on a reference built from the wrong tensor

deviations_from_the_paper.rendering: apply_chat_template through the harness's one renderer (sisteer.models.build_chat_prompt), not their hardcoded per-family template strings.

checks.rule: phase=both, positions=all, skip_bos=False, coeff=1.0, and op_needs_context is False — so the edit lands on every token of every forward, prefill AND every decode step, which IS Arditi's ungated pre-hook. This level encodes the whole point of the spec: the prefill-only arm is the DEVIATION this one corrects

the rung is exported to a PEFT adapter and read back through the WORKER's own validator: mode all (MODE_ALL), op add_vector, coeff 1.0, skip_bos False, boundaries [the served layer], and the payload tensor bit-equal to the blob's — so the lens and native paths are shown to carry the same bytes before either serves a request

checks.rule: every decode row's output is h + c x r_raw bit-exactly, and the realised dose ||edit||/||h|| at the reference denominator equals the arithmetic alpha_equiv to 1e-5 relative
